Edgar Rice Burroughs, At the Earth’s Core.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-rice-burroughs/at-the-earths-core

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Rice Burroughs, the author, died 1950 (Wikidata Q148234, P570 = 1950-03-19).

First publication of the text used: 1914, in the United States; serialized in All-Story Weekly, a United States magazine, from April 1914; book by A. C. McClurg, United States, 1922. SE colophon: 'At the Earth’s Core was published in 1914 by Edgar Rice Burroughs.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1914, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2009.
- Country of origin (United States): the country of first publication is the United States, so the rule above settles the country of origin too.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
